propositions: pytest-xdist worker crashes nondeterministically on Python 3.11 when running test_matching_guard_is_accepted, surfacing as 'node down: Not properly terminated' and blocking the Verified gate
CPython 3.11 asyncio.wait_for consumes external cancellation when child completes in same event-loop turn, leaving worker task in cancelling state and parked at queue.get()
Replaced asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(...), timeout=...) with async with asyncio.timeout(...): await asyncio.to_thread(...) to restore correct cancellation semantics
Crash is Python 3.11-specific and load-dependent; Python 3.12+ unaffected; reproducible locally under CPU contention
Fix commit 8c9bf5d78d added regression test test_worker_cancellation_survives_job_completion_race confirming worker task completes on shutdown cancellation
Original ThreadPoolExecutor hypothesis was falsified; actual root cause was asyncio cancellation consumption bug, not executor disposal
